blue ink, surrounded by a colorful array

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even if I say so myself, it's a 
masterpiece! The color balance is 
perfection, wouldn't you say?

Kyumaru is a heartwarming kappa
character. 
He's quite popular and even has a movie 
series.

"Ugh,
no matter how many times I watch it,

text_block_list.text:
To save the field, Kyumaru tries to take

cry every single time...

text_block_list.text:
Startled by the sudden appearance of such 
a legend, I instinctively straighten my 
posture. Symboli Rudolf—Student Council 
President of Tracen Academy,
and the first 
Umamusume to achieve 7 turf GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Make yourself comfortable. I merely 
came out for a stroll."
choice_data_list: (It all started with her—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still—Almond Eye. There isn't a day where 
I don't see you at the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I love training! Because it makes me 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you spare a 
moment?
I've been wanting to have a proper 
talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you're aiming for the Tiara
route. 
Naturally, your goal is... the Triple 
Tiara?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I think it would be wonderful if I won
it. 
However, it isn't something I am 
specifically aiming for!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's someone I really want to beat.
If 
she chooses a different path, then—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So you went over there. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I watched your Make Debut race, too. 
You have limitless potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:

Then, what is your dream?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It is to win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text: Yes! Winning is my dream.

even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

future, 
I eagerly look forward to that day.

why

the next generation. The racing world 
continues to move forward—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:

unprecedented.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:

future, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.text:

Always—only the present 
moment."
